# First combined-runtime correctness pass V103

Explicit package-only InferenceOptimizations.integrationCandidate composes compact state windows, compact MTP row, final-forward elision, value-only sampler threshold and device draw, bounded output queue, responsive governor and exact256-token checkpoint retention. Row-backed embedding is separately selected at construction. Public initializer/environment defaults remain unchanged; this factory is not a claim of joint qualification.

The V103 ordinary combined diagnostic passes151 assertions. Reference and candidate models run sequentially at640slots; only hashes/scalars/token IDs survive between arms. Every logical state/representation field and continued logits is bit-exact at17/255/256/257/1025tokens and with real images wholly before/crossing256. Both filtered/unfiltered sampling and two seeds replay exactly and match the reference. Eight-output greedy completions execute8reference versus7candidate decode model tokens, proving the intended unused-forward removal. Repeated and edited prefixes, interleaved auxiliary/divergent requests and callback cancellation/retry are exact; actual256-token reuse is checked. No performance or peak-memory qualification follows from diagnostic duration.

A subsequent source review finds that public State() and tokenCount can reach unchecked QSA cache access or position overflow. A successor adds pre-mutation checks for initialized cache-key sets, offsets and signed32-bit position bounds, plus invalid-input atomicity assertions. That successor is not built or tested in this record: its V104 build is waiting for another task's model reservation. MTP and the joint serving matrix remain pending, and defaults are not activated.
